## 1. Hypotheses and decision rules (verbatim from RESEARCH_SUMMARY)

## 2. Hypotheses and the single finding

| ID | Statement | Measure | Falsified or limited when |
|---|---|---|---|
| **F1 / H1 (primary)** | Training increases a persistent H₁ signal that distinguishes the cylinder from the square | $D_{r,i}$ (§7.4) | Any of the decision-rule conditions in §7.4 fails while all gates passed |
| H2 | Activation geometry follows the 32-symbol belief more than the last-symbol posterior | $\Delta_\text{geom}$, overall and within pairs with the same last symbol (§7.5) | $\Delta_\text{geom}\le 0$, or the effect vanishes within same-last-symbol pairs |
| H3 | Under the axis-permuted emission P, $D_r>0$ still holds, so the structure is learned from dynamics and not only from emission geometry | F1 rule applied to P | The rule fails under P although the learning gate passed |
| H4 | $S$ rises only after the model starts using history (regret drops below $G_C$) | curves over 12 checkpoints; checkpoint-order permutation null | $S$ rises before history use |
| H0 | Under identical emissions nothing about the latent state is learnable | NLL ≥ $H(W)$ within CI; $b\equiv\pi$ | NLL below $H(W)$ indicates leakage or a bug |

### 7.4 F1 decision rule
For replicate $r$ and panel $i$ (the same panel index in both worlds):
$$D_{r,i}=(S^{cyl}_{final,i}-S^{cyl}_{init,i})-(S^{sq}_{final,i}-S^{sq}_{init,i}).$$
Let $u_r=\max_{c}\ q_{95}\{|S_{c,i}-S_{c,j}|:i<j\}$ over the four cells $c\in\{$cyl-final, cyl-init, sq-final, sq-init$\}$.

**F1 is supported** iff all of the following hold:
1. $D_{r,i}>0$ for at least 7 of the 8 panels in **each** of the 3 replicates;
2. $\mathrm{median}_i D_{r,i}>u_r$ for each replicate;
3. every model passed the learning gate.

**F1 is rejected** iff all gates passed and condition 1 or 2 fails. **Otherwise the result is inconclusive**, and the report names the failed gate.

The four $S$ values are always reported next to $D$.

### 7.5 H2 measure
On all pairs within a panel:
$$\Delta_\text{geom}=\rho_s(d_A,d_{B32})-\rho_s(d_A,d_{B1}),$$
computed again restricted to pairs with the same $w_{32}$. The decision is the sign consistency across 3 replicates and 8 panels. Pair correlations are never significance tests.

### 7.6 Representation baselines (same pipeline)
- **R0:** the model at initialisation.
- **R1:** the trained model's embedding of the last symbol.
- **R2 (previous-token mixing):** $\tfrac12[\phi(w_{32})+\phi(w_{31})]$, where $\phi$ is the spectral embedding (8–16 components) of the symbol transition matrix $E^\top\mathrm{diag}(\pi)TE$.
- **R3 (context average):** $\tfrac1{32}\sum_t\phi(w_t)$.

If R2 or R3 show $D>0$ of similar size, F1 under O is explained by simple mixing, and the conclusion rests on P.

## 3. Discriminability of unlearned spaces (S2, replicate 1729, all 8 panels)

| space | cond | median S cylinder | median S square | panels cyl > sq |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| belief32 | O | 0.671 | 0.321 | 8/8 |
| belief32 | P | 0.323 | 0.310 | 5/8 |
| belief1 | O | 0.324 | 0.165 | 8/8 |
| belief1 | P | 0.324 | 0.165 | 8/8 |
| future1 | O | 0.556 | 0.189 | 8/8 |
| future1 | P | 0.194 | 0.241 | 1/8 |
| future2 | O | 0.614 | 0.216 | 8/8 |
| future2 | P | 0.202 | 0.242 | 2/8 |
| world (all 144 states) | — | 0.299 | 0.037 | — |
| emission (all 144 states) | O | 0.568 | 0.108 | — |
| emission (all 144 states) | P | 0.568 | 0.108 | — |

Gaussian floor of S (belief32, panel 1, Hellinger embedding; context only):

| world | cond | iso mean | iso q95 | cov mean | cov q95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cylinder | O | 0.052 | 0.061 | 0.088 | 0.098 |
| cylinder | P | 0.055 | 0.061 | 0.067 | 0.077 |
| square | O | 0.055 | 0.065 | 0.084 | 0.095 |
| square | P | 0.054 | 0.061 | 0.067 | 0.077 |

World-difference rule (D-023): a space differs if S_cyl > S_sq in ≥ 7 of 8 panels.

**Which hypotheses are decidable (conductor note):** Under O every unlearned space separates the worlds in 8/8 panels, at 3-8x the Gaussian floor (belief32 median S 0.671 vs 0.321), so F1 and H2 are decidable; b32 and b1 geometries differ (cylinder 0.671 vs 0.324). The E1 stop path is not triggered. Under P the exact belief b32 shows no reliable world difference (5/8 panels; 0.323 vs 0.310) and the future spaces reverse (1/8, 2/8), while b1 and the emission field are permutation-invariant clouds and keep their O values. Hence H3 is decidable one-sidedly only: D_r > 0 under P would be informative, but a failure under P is expected even for the ideal predictor and will NOT be read as evidence that structure comes from emission geometry.

## 4. Fixed analysis choices

Primary hook `resid_post_3` at checkpoint 5000; 8 panels × 512 histories at p = 32 (HistoryIndex artifacts of S2); activations: raw Euclidean; distributions: Hellinger; S = max finite H₁ persistence / q95 of positive distances; F1 rule: ≥ 7/8 positive panels in each of 3 replicates and median D > u_r (strict); learning gate captured ≥ 0.8.

## 7. base.yaml

```yaml
# Closed decisions (docs/RESEARCH_SUMMARY.md §8). Change only via human checkpoint H3.
# After S2 completes, any change here raises CONFIG_DRIFT unless waived with a reason.
schema_version: "1.0.0"

seeds:
  masters: [1729, 2718, 3141]          # replicate seeds
  world_scoped: true                   # P permutations and the test split do not depend on the replicate

worlds:
  core: [cylinder, square]
  dims: [12, 12]
  metric: flat                         # sensitivity: graph

dynamics:
  kind: max_degree_lazy_walk
  p_stay: 0.2

emissions:
  V: 36
  center_strategy: grid                # c_ab = (0.5+2a, 0.5+2b), a,b in 0..5
  sigma_candidates: [1.25, 0.75, 2.0]  # tried in this order
  sigma_rule:
    min_mean_entropy_b1: 0.6931471805599453   # log 2
    min_context_gain_nats: 0.10
    min_symbol_prob_factor: 0.5                # p(w) >= 0.5 / V
    fallback_min_context_gain_nats: 0.03       # flagged "weak context"
  conditions: {O: overlap, P: axis_permuted, N: identical, U: unique}

sequences:
  n_obs: 33
  context: 32
  analysis_position: 32
  bos: true

data:
  n_train: 131072
  n_dev: 4096
  n_test: 4096
  n_panels: 8
  panel_size: 512

model:
  n_layers: 4
  d_model: 128
  n_heads: 4
  d_mlp: 512
  activation: gelu
  dropout: 0.0
  tie_embeddings: false
  hooks: [embed, resid_post_0, resid_post_1, resid_post_2, resid_post_3, ln_final_out]
  primary_hook: resid_post_3

training:
  steps: 5000
  batch_size: 128
  lr: 1.0e-3
  warmup: 200
  schedule: cosine
  weight_decay: 0.1
  grad_clip: 1.0
  checkpoints: [0, 50, 100, 200, 400, 700, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000]
  primary_checkpoint: 5000

learning_gate:
  captured_min: 0.8                    # captured = 1 - regret / G_C at p = 32

topology:
  filtration: vietoris_rips
  coeff_p: 2
  maxdim: 1
  threshold: auto
  scale: q95_positive_distances
  activation_metric: euclidean         # raw, no PCA
  distribution_metric: hellinger
  gaussian_floor_draws: 20

f1_rule:
  min_positive_panels: 7               # out of 8, per replicate
  envelope_quantile: 0.95
  median_must_exceed_envelope: true    # strict inequality

baselines:
  representation: [R0, R1, R2, R3]
  spectral_components: 12
  ngram_orders: [1, 2]
```
